cards.title: Read-Your-Writes Anomaly
items: Client writes to Primary; Primary ACKs immediately
Primary replicates asynchronously to Replica 1 and Replica 2, with lag
If the client reads from Replica 2 right away, before replication finishes, it gets stale data

cards.title: This Is Not a Bug
items: It's a deliberate trade-off: async replication gives lower write latency and higher availability
The system is 'eventually consistent' - every replica converges to the same value once the replication lag passes
The issue only appears in the short window right after a write

cards.title: How to Guarantee Read-Your-Writes
items: Sticky session to Primary for the client that just wrote, for a short window
Read from Primary for the request right after a write, then switch back to replica reads
Session/causal consistency: the server remembers the written version and waits for the replica to catch up before responding
Versioned reads: the client sends the version it wrote; the replica refuses to answer until it has caught up
